The text analyzes the conditional relations (*paccaya*) governing phenomena classified according to the matrix of the dyad on states conjoined with consciousness (*cittasaṁsaṭṭhaduka*) combined with the primary triad on wholesome, unwholesome, and indeterminate states (*kusalattika*).
